title: The Complete Qur'an
description: The Complete Quran as Written Books! 114 chapters, 6,236 verses in 133 beautifully formatted written books. Single command installation.
body:
![The Complete Qur'an](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1a442786884fa5f0130420ca231c483dd56240e1.jpeg)  
# The Complete Quran

  Read the complete Quran in your Minecraft world! This datapack creates all 114 chapters and 6,236 verses as
  readable written books, beautifully organized and accessible with a single command.

  I created a discord for anybody willing to help proof read or if any errors are found.
  https://discord.gg/EjgYfwW3er

  Or Email 
  AaronKylePorche@gmail.com

  ## ✨ Features

  - 📖 **All 114 Surahs (Chapters)** of the Quran in English
  - 🎯 Complete Quran contained in **133 Written Books**
  - 📦 **5 Color-Coded Shulker Boxes** organized by chapter range
  - ✅ 6,236 verses **100% Complete** (need ingame proof reading help)
  - 🌍 **Translation:** Talal Itani's "Clear Quran"
  - ⚡ **Easy Installation** - one command to place a chest with all books inside!

  ## 🚀 Installation

  1. Download the datapack ZIP file
  2. Navigate to your Minecraft world folder:
     - Windows: `%appdata%\.minecraft\saves\[YourWorld]\datapacks`
     - Mac: `~/Library/Application Support/minecraft/saves/[YourWorld]/datapacks`
     - Linux: `~/.minecraft/saves/[YourWorld]/datapacks`
  3. Place the `QuranDataPack` folder inside the `datapacks` folder
  4. In-game, run: `/reload`
  5. Run: `/function quran:placequran`

  A chest will appear containing 5 shulker boxes with all the books!

  ## 📦 What's Inside the Chest

  | Shulker Color | Chapters |
  |--------------|----------|
  | 🖤 **Black** | 1-12 (Al-Fatiha through Yusuf) |
  | 🔴 **Red** | 13-35 (Ar-Ra'd through Fatir) |
  | ⚪ **White** | 36-62 (Ya-Sin through Al-Mumtahina) |
  | ⚫ **Gray** | 63-89 (Al-Munafiqun through Al-Fajr) |
  | 🟤 **Brown** | 90-114 (Al-Balad through An-Nas) |

  ## 🎮 Requirements

  - Minecraft Java Edition 1.20.5 or newer
  - No mods or plugins required
  - Works in both singleplayer and multiplayer
